sources.name: Unicode CLDR
sources.version: 48.0 (as shipped in ICU 78.3 with Node 22.23.4; plural rules compared with cldr-json main on 2026-11-11)

provenance.notes: Written in this phase from the cited references and re-expressed; the Arabic text is the researcher's own wording and needs a native reviewer. The checks are proposals for the harness, not yet run.

statement.ar: التاريخ الرقمي المكتوب يُحلَّل بالترتيب المعلن للحقل فقط. إذا كان للمدخل قراءتان صحيحتان ولم يُعلن الترتيب فاطلب التوضيح. في العرض استخدم اسم الشهر حيث يتسع المكان.
statement.en: A typed numeric date is parsed only in the field's declared order. If the input has two valid readings and no order is declared, ask. In display, use the month name wherever space allows.

rationale.ar: «03/04/2026» هو 3 أبريل عند معظم العرب و4 مارس في صيغة أمريكية؛ الخطأ لا يظهر حتى يفوت الموعد.
rationale.en: "03/04/2026" is 3 April for most Arabic readers and 4 March in US format; the error does not show until the appointment is missed.

checks: dates DT-typed-01 and DT-typed-04: a parser without a declared order returns ambiguity, never a date.
A date field shows its order (placeholder or segment labels) and accepts digits of any system in every segment.
Long date formats contain a month name; no all-numeric date is rendered without a visible order convention in the same view.
